name: One For All
description: An inherited Quirk that accumulates power and can be passed from one holder to another. The official anime terminology guide describes its origin as the combination of a stockpiling Quirk and a transfer Quirk.
origin: Created through the combination of Yoichi Shigaraki’s transfer Quirk and a stockpiling Quirk forcibly given to him; passed through successive holders.
strengths: Can be transferred to another person
specialAbilities: Later holders can access Quirks inherited from previous holders

name: Explosion
description: Katsuki Bakugo secretes a nitro-like substance from his palms and can ignite it to produce explosions.

name: Zero Gravity
description: Ochaco Uraraka can make objects weightless by touching them with the pads on her fingertips.
strengths: Can remove the weight of touched objects

name: Half-Cold Half-Hot
description: Shoto Todoroki produces ice from his right side and flames from his left side.

name: Hardening
description: Eijiro Kirishima can harden his body, providing offensive and defensive utility.

name: Creation
description: Momo Yaoyorozu can create non-living objects from her body.
strengths: Can produce a wide range of non-living objects

name: Engine
description: Tenya Iida has engine-like organs in his calves that allow him to run at extraordinary speed.

name: Ten Shadows Technique
description: A hereditary jujutsu technique of the Zenin family used by Megumi Fushiguro.

name: Construction Technique
description: Mai Zenin uses cursed energy to construct matter from nothing.
strengths: Can construct matter using cursed energy

name: Cursed Speech
description: A cursed technique associated with the Inumaki family; Toge Inumaki is a user.
specialAbilities: Uses spoken commands as a cursed technique

name: Exploding Blood
description: Nezuko Kamado’s Blood Demon Art ignites her blood in a pink flame.
origin: Nezuko’s demon abilities after being transformed by Muzan Kibutsuji.
specialAbilities: Creates an explosive pink flame from blood

name: Psychic Powers
description: Momo Ayase awakens hidden psychic powers after being abducted by the Serpoians.
origin: Awakened during her encounter with the Serpoians.
specialAbilities: Psychic abilities; individual techniques are tracked separately when verified

name: Spirit-Medium Barrier
description: Seiko Ayase is a spirit medium capable of placing a barrier around her house.
strengths: Can establish a protective barrier around her home

name: Esper / Psychic Powers
description: Shigeo “Mob” Kageyama possesses exceptionally powerful psychic abilities.
specialAbilities: Psychic power; individual named techniques require further title-specific verification

name: Ice and Snow Powers
description: Elsa has magical ice and snow powers; Disney’s official film synopsis states that her powers trap Arendelle in eternal winter.
